title: Johnny Dede on banjo and George Ginnon as substitute
summary: Johnny Dede was the band's regular banjoist; George Ginnon filled in on road trips.

blocks.x: Who was the regular banjo player with Sam on it? Johnny Deade He was with him for years?

Oh yeah Johnny Deade was He was with the band when Young Morgan had the band in charge He was with him You understand? And after Sam He took the first stroke Well his band we had then with him understand They got rid of him you see? They all go for themselves you know? So after Sam come in the band with his brother and his brother you see? And worked him until the time that he passed away you see? And we had a good band at the time then
Who would he send in his place when he couldn't come Johnny Deade?

Johnny Deade He sent George Ginnon George Ginnon he used to make them road trips when Johnny couldn't go make them you see? Johnny was plastered with plastered with you see? And when he schools going up then he was with Sam George in his place you see?
